data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for WireGuard VPN implementation across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that sets up and controls WireGuard VPN connections. It provides traffic statistics, tunnel management, split tunneling, and key generation across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
use_when: You need to establish and manage WireGuard VPN connections in a Flutter app.
You need real-time download and upload traffic statistics for active VPN sessions.
You require cross-platform VPN support including desktop and mobile environments.
avoid_when: Your app uses a different VPN protocol (e.g., OpenVPN) instead of WireGuard.
You cannot perform platform-specific setup for native Network Extensions on Apple platforms.
strengths: Cross-platform support covering Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Real-time traffic statistics and connection stage streams.
Modern support including Android 16KB page sizes.
weaknesses: Requires complex native configuration on Apple platforms (Network Extensions, App Groups).
Desktop platforms require specific privileges or external tools (Admin privileges on Windows, wireguard-tools and openresolv on Linux).
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a Network Extension target and configuring App Groups in Xcode for iOS and macOS. Windows requires running as Administrator, and Linux requires installing wireguard-tools and openresolv.
